Name: Bigger Ores
Author: soda5cm
Description:
[size=5][b]Bigger Ores[/b][/size]

Ever wished the mines had something worth swinging at for a while? [b]Bigger Ores adds rare, big 2x2 ore boulders[/b] to the Mines, the Skull Cavern and the Quarry. They are tough, they need a good pickaxe, and they pay out a nice pile of ore.

[b]Available in English and Russian.[/b]

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]

[size=3][b]Where to find them[/b][/size]
Place — Boulder
Mines, floors 1–39 — Copper
Mines, floors 40–79 — Iron
Mines, floors 80–119 — Gold
Skull Cavern — Iridium
Quarry Mine and the Quarry (after the bridge is repaired) — Copper, iron or gold

[list]
[*][b]17%[/b] chance per mine level (rolled once when the level is generated), [b]25%[/b] per day in the Quarry.[/*]
[*]No boulders on treasure / elevator floors (10, 20, 30...).[/*]
[*]Boulders never block a corridor: they only appear in open spots.[/*]
[/list]
[size=3][b]Mining them[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]You need the right pickaxe:[/b] copper boulder — Copper Pickaxe, iron — Steel, gold — Gold, iridium — Iridium. With a weaker pickaxe the boulder just clanks and shows a "Too hard!" message.[/*]
[*][b]12 hits[/b] with the minimum pickaxe, each upgrade above it hits 50% harder (12 / 8 / 6 / 5 hits).[/*]
[*][b]Ore drops while you work[/b] — about half of it comes out as you hit, the rest when the boulder breaks. The total is the same no matter which pickaxe you use.[/*]
[*]Loot: copper / iron 10–14 ore, gold 8–12, iridium 5–8, plus [b]10 stone[/b], mining XP, and a bonus for the [b]Miner[/b] profession.[/*]
[*]The boulders use the vanilla ore node sprites scaled up, so they fit right in and work with ore retextures.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Config[/b][/size]
Everything can be changed in [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] (optional) or in [font=Courier New]config.json[/font]:
[list]
[*]turn mine / quarry boulders on or off;[/*]
[*]spawn chance for mine levels and for the quarry;[/*]
[*]number of hits with the minimum pickaxe;[/*]
[*]ore multiplier;[/*]
[*]show or hide the "Too hard!" message.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.14+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0+[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (optional)[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Unzip the mod into your [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Multiplayer:[/b] works, but [b]every player needs the mod[/b].[/*]
[*]Nothing is written to your save: unbroken boulders are removed overnight, so the mod can be removed at any time.[/*]
[*]Console command for testing: [font=Courier New]bo_spawn <copper|iron|gold|iridium>[/font] spawns a boulder next to you.[/*]
[/list]
Bugs or ideas? Leave a comment!

Also check out my other mods: [b]Lazy Farmer[/b], [b]Auto Tool Swap & Return[/b] and [b]Bundle Highlighter & Item Encyclopedia[/b].

[i]Also on CurseForge.[/i]
